name: Terravun
bio: Terravun can move literal mountains. He is the very Titan that helped quarry out Stoneloom, using his awesome might to carve the labyrinthine tunnels that the Stonehearts call home. Since then, many Stonehearts have tried to Invoke Terravun; each time, the dragon has refused to reappear. But whenever Stoneloom truly needs him, Terravun will spring to its aid again.
subtitle: The Earthcarver

effects.label: Blind
effects.description: The recipient has a percentage chance to miss their Combo Attacks, and not deal any damage. Combo Attacks that are missed do not generate any Mana for the attacker. Miss chance stacks along with any Miss chance from other sources, such as from skills.

effects.label: Deflection
effects.description: Redirects a percentage of all incoming damage from the recipient of the buff to the caster of the buff. The recipient takes the remainder of the damage as normal.

effects.label: ATK Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Attack stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Stun
effects.description: The recipient cannot move or attack, and Passive Skills are disabled.Active Skill cooldowns continue to count down as normal.The recipient will continue to take 100% damage from incoming attacks.

effects.label: Weaken
effects.description: Increase the damage the recipient takes from all attacks by the indicated percentage.
